description: Your Recourse Pool membership: status (not_member, protected, grace — still protected — or lapsed), when protection started, when the next month begins, the next burn, the contribution if that month has no earnings, the earnings contribution percent, and any unpaid amount (awaiting automatic collection while protected; to complete before rejoining after a lapse). Also the current month's rule — set by the signed membership rule on the Recourse Pool contract on Base — the pool reserve, and any open membership action. Membership is optional; it restores stolen PVT only, at the pool's discretion. Read-only. Requires agent API credentials.
name: recourse_status
